sections.title: Section 1: University Language Centre
sections.html:
seek

(verb). tìm kiếm

He decided to seek the opinion of a co-worker on the problem.

manage

(verb). xoay sở, có thể làm được

It took me a long time, but I managed to fix the car by myself.

preferable

(adjective). hợp lý hơn, thích hợp hơn

Do you think having a cup of coffee in the morning is more preferable to a cup of tea?

option

(noun). sự lựa chọn

After graduating, I had several options to choose from.

intensive

(adjective). mạnh mẽ, dồn dập, cấp tốc

Participants will take part in an intensive training course that will last for two weeks.

crash course

(noun). khóa học cấp tốc

I'm thinking of doing an online crash course in English pronunciation.

proficiency

(noun). trình độ

Usually, there are 6 levels of proficiency in any language, namely A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, and C2.

intermediate

(adjective). trung cấp

The intermediate course is harder than the beginner course, but easier than the advanced one.

demand

(noun). nhu cầu

Demand for food is always increasing over time.

emphasis

(noun). điểm nhấn

Nowadays, a lot of emphasis is placed on being different from everyone else.

on a day-to-day basis

(adverb). hằng ngày

To be in shape, you need to exercise on a day-to-day basis.

communicate

(verb). nói chuyện, giao tiếp

We have many different ways to communicate with each other nowadays.

conversation

(noun). cuộc nói chuyện, cuộc hội thoại

Do you mind if we have a quick conversation about this?

statistic

(noun). số liệu

There are a lot of statistics here, but you only need to pick out the important ones.

profile

(noun). hồ sơ

Almost everyone has a Facebook profile nowadays.

leap year

(noun). năm nhuận

In a leap year, there's an extra day at the end of February.

give up

(verb). bỏ cuộc, bỏ dở

You never know how close you are to success, so don't give up.

sections.title: Section 2: Different Breeds Of Working Dogs
sections.html:
illustrate

(verb). minh họa

This picture illustrates how to make lemonade.

reputation

(noun). danh tiếng

The company is having a problem with its bad reputation.

loyal >> loyalty (n)

(adjective). trung thành

Dogs are extremely loyal and therefore they make great pets.

statue

(noun). tượng

The statue of David by Michelangelo is one of the most popular in the world.

commemorate

(verb). tưởng nhớ

The town is holding a special ceremony to commemorate those who have died during the war.

herd

(verb). chăn

Farmers are herding sheep on those hills.

in unison

(adverb). cùng với nhau

Everyone is singing in unison.

obedient

(adjective). ngoan ngoãn, biết nghe lời

Many parents teach their chiildren to be obedient from a young age.

gentle

(adjective). nhẹ nhàng

Remember to be gentle when you hold the baby.

assistance

(noun). sự giúp đỡ

Due to her age, she requires assistance in order to travel.

donation

(noun). đồ quyên góp, đồ được tặng

If everyone makes a small donation, we will reach our goal soon.

appropriate

(adjective). hợp lý, thích hợp

You can't use that kind of language at work because it is not appropriate.

rescue

(verb). giải cứu

They are rescuing people from a boating accident.

disaster

(noun). thảm họa

Vietnam faced a terrible flooding disaster a few months ago.

courageous

(adjective). dũng cảm

Only the most courageous men would be willing to fight the dragon.

cope with

(verb). đối phó với

How do you cope with stress from work?

database

(noun). cơ sở dữ liệu, kho dữ liệu

All of the computers here are connected to the same database.

baggage

(noun). hành lý

Don't bring too much stuff with you while travelling, since the airline would make you pay more for excess baggage.

sniff

(verb). ngửi thấy, đánh hơi

My dog is sniffing something in the garden.

enormous

(adjective). to lớn, khổng lồ

That is an enormous cow.

adapt

(verb). thích nghi, thích ứng

She's finding it hard to adapt to the cold winter.

harsh

(adjective). nghiêm khắc

Don't be so harsh on your children.

earn

(verb). giành được, kiếm được

He's earning a lot of money by working from home.

practical

(adjective). thiết thực, mang tính áp dụng thực tiễn

It's important to teach students the practical uses of their subjects instead of just the theories.

vital

(adjective). quan trọng

It's vital to keep a distance with other people during Covid-19

valuable

(adjective). quý giá

A good idea can be very valuable.

sight

(noun). thị giác

My sight has become worse over the years, so now I need to wear these glasses.

workshop

(noun). xưởng

There are a lot of tools in the workshop.

invent

(verb). sáng chế

Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone in 1876.

institute

They are working together at the research institute.

military

(adjective). thuộc quân sự

He is joining a military training.

army

(noun). quân đội

battle

(noun). trận chiến

The battle went on for days, resulting in the death of many soldiers.

arrangement

(noun). cách sắp xếp

You should try to find a good arrangement for those pictures.

combination

(noun). cách kết hợp

With four people, there are six different combinations that have two people in each.

represent

(verb). đại diện cho

According to traditional belief, a four leaf clover represents good luck.

individual >> individually (adv)

(adjective). riêng biệt

Individual wellbeing is becoming more and more important in this era.

officially >> official (adj)

(adverb). một cách chính thức

They officially became a married couple.

adopt

(verb). đón nhận, chấp nhận để sử dụng

For some reasons, the company is not adopting the latest technology that would make their work a lot easier.

catch on

(verb). trở nên phổ biến

Tiktok has caught on and become just as popular as other social media platforms that came before it.

fellow

(adjective). đồng trang lứa

He enjoys spending time with fellow students.

unusual

(adjective). khác thường

That house is one of the most unusual I have ever seen.

backwards / in reverse

(adverb). ngược lại

Can you read this message that is written backwards?

device

(noun). thiết bị

You can connect to the Internet using many different mobile devices.

notation

(noun). ghi chú, kí hiệu ghi chú

Let's look at some of the most common musical notations.

informal

(adjective). thân mật

The meeting is quite informal, so feel free to ask any question you have.

obvious

(adjective). rõ ràng, hiển nhiên

It's obvious that she doesn't like broccoli.

memory

In chemistry class, we sometimes get to do fun and interesting experiments.

We put the baby in his cot so he can sleep.

remove

(verb). bỏ đi, bỏ ra chỗ khác

observe

(verb). quan sát

They went on a trip to Africa to observe wild animals.

(noun). hai tuần

In Australia, people usually get paid every fortnight instead of every month.

random

(adjective). ngẫu nhiên

survive

(verb). tồn tại, sống sót

The flowers survive even though it grows on dry and rocky ground.

One person can be linked to many other people in their community.

(adjective). hạn chế, ít

You'll have a limited amount of time to finish this project.

capable

(adjective). có khả năng

He's capable of doing many things at one time.

store

(verb). lưu trữ

He stores his money in a big jar.

retrieve

(verb). lấy lại

My dog knows how to retrieved the stick I just threw away.

incident

(noun). sự cố

I had a small incident on the way to work this morning.

interrupt

(verb). làm gián đoạn, đứt quãng

It is not very polite to interrupt people while they're talking.

stage

(noun). giai đoạn

Now that we've thought of a good idea, the next stage is to find more information.

demanding

(adjective). khó khăn, đòi hỏi nhiều thứ

His job is very demanding, and there's always something to do all the time.

recall

(noun). khả năng nhớ lại

He has a good recall of where he put the little things.

slip

(verb). trượt, rớt xuống

He slipped on a puddle and fell on the floor.

manage

(verb). xoay sở, có thể làm được

It took me a long time, but I managed to fix the car by myself.

respond

(verb). phản ứng, phản hồi

She knows how to respond in an emergency.

familiar

(adjective). quen thuộc

The children are familiar with the puzzle so it shouldn't take long for them to finish it.

demonstrate

(verb). trình bày, cho thấy

Steve Jobs demonstrated how the iPhone works.

grasp

(verb). hiểu

She failed to grasp anything he was talking about.

analogy

(noun). phép so sánh

The teacher showed an analogy between the Earth and a peach.
